web-guide-idea-2.audience: People abroad who miss the rhythm of morning worship at home.
web-guide-idea-2.offer: Offer a calm, reliably timed home aarti with an explanation in your own language. The personal ritual and familiar voice are the attraction.
web-guide-idea-2.steps.0: Frame your home shrine and test lamp exposure.
web-guide-idea-2.steps.1: Welcome viewers, explain the ritual and perform your usual aarti.
web-guide-idea-2.steps.2: Leave a few minutes for the meaning of a prayer and the next session time.
web-guide-idea-2.equipment: Your phone, a stable stand, reliable Wi-Fi and your usual puja items. Keep the phone and charging cables safely away from flames.
web-guide-idea-2.returnReason: A consistent morning slot can become a comforting routine. Vary the explanation or festival focus without promising spiritual results.
web-guide-idea-2.promotion: Post a photo of your prepared shrine and name the prayer, language and time zone. Let people know this is a home ritual.
web-guide-idea-2.metadataTitle: Subah Ki Aarti — Creator Idea & Practical Guide · Saathum
web-guide-idea-2.metadataDescription: Bring a morning aarti to people far from home, from your home shrine or a temple that permits streaming. Learn what to offer, how to start and what equipment you need.
